summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Tehachapi Unified School District to issue $61 million in bonds for school facilities, repaid by property taxes estimated at $28.65 per $100,000 of assessed value per year.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports a $61 million local bond to finance school-facility improvements and obtain state matching funds.
tax.quote: Bond Measure D works in tandem with state matching grants (over $22 million) to maximize local taxpayer dollars, prioritizing essential modernization and reinvestment into existing facilities over broad campus expansion.

schools.text: A Yes vote supports directing local bond money and state matching funds to facilities across Tehachapi Unified School District campuses.
schools.quote: Securing local bond funds allows Tehachapi USD to unlock approximately $22.4 million in State Modernization matching grants.

tax.text: A No vote opposes the district's proposed $61 million general-obligation bond for school facilities.
tax.quote: Bond Measure D evaluates a $61 million local general obligation bond measure.
